bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches aren't allowed. Camelbacks and bota bags must be emptied before they can come in.
allowed: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: Backpacks or bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.quote: Backpacks or large bags larger than 12" x 6" x 12"

parking.summary: Space Ballroom has free parking for guests in the venue's own lot.
parking.quote: We have free parking for our patrons in our venue's parking lot.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Space Ballroom. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Two full bars serve craft and domestic drafts and cans, plus some snacks. Outside beverages and open containers aren't allowed.
allowed: Drinks and snacks from the venue bars
concessions.quote: We have two full bars with a variety of craft and domestic drafts and cans.

accessibility.summary: Space Ballroom is ADA accessible. For questions about ADA seating or access, email customersupport@manicpresents.com. Service animals and guide dogs with valid credentials are allowed, but other animals and pets are not.
allowed: Service animals and guide dogs with valid credentials
accessibility.quote: We are an ADA accessible venue.

reEntry.summary: Space Ballroom hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Advance tickets are sold through Eventbrite, and the box office opens only one hour before doors, taking cash, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Shows are all ages unless posted otherwise. Bring a valid, unexpired government-issued photo ID if you plan to drink, or you'll be treated as under 21.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office is only open one hour before any show's doors open.

gates.summary: Space Ballroom hasn't published entrance and door details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
